names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 martie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Alexandru preotul».

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 15 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети мученик Александар.“, with the rank words Свети мученик left off. The heading gives no city — Side of Pamphylia is the body's first sentence — so the bare forename is what the source gives.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 15 марта ст. ст., «Александр Сидский (Памфилийский), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The day's own line declines the name to «Александра» and puts the city in a phrase, «иерея в Сиде», rather than in the name.

death.note: doxologia.ro opens the life «Împărățind Aurelian (270-275) și fiind prigonire asupra creștinilor». The interval is the reign the page prints; it gives no year.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Александра, иерея в Сиде (279-275).»

attestations.note: The julian 15/3 agrees with the Serbian julian 15/3 this folder already carried; the Romanian keeps him a day earlier on its revised-julian 14/3. The figure the line closes with, «(279-275)», runs backwards and can be no reign, and the life page behind the same line names «при императоре Аврелиане (270 - 275)» — which is exactly the interval this folder already holds from doxologia. The line's figure is therefore read as a slip of this page against itself, the interval is unchanged, and the slip is recorded here rather than averaged. The day page prints no hymn under his name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 martie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Alexandru preotul»

attestations.note: Not checked: saint.gr for 14 Μαρτίου (19 September 2026).

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 28.03.2026 (15. март ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Александар.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry, and plainly this presbyter: he is from the city of Side in Pamphylia, he is questioned by a governor of the emperor Aurelian, he answers that he is a shepherd of the flock of Christ, and the entry closes „Пострада свети Александар између 270. и 275. године“ — which is the same interval, and the same reign, that this folder already holds from doxologia. The two calendars keep him on two days: doxologia on 14 March, which this folder's Romanian row carries, and the Prologue on 15 March. Two churches keeping one man on two days is ordinary and is not a second feast on one church. The entry adds what doxologia did not: the ox sinews, the furnace that did not harm him, the flesh scraped off him, and the judge who was seized by an evil spirit the moment he had passed sentence and vomited out his own soul on the way to his idol. The stored form is the bare forename, because Свети мученик is the rank and the heading gives no city. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
